permissions.network: none required for inspect/plan; GitHub repository creation planning requires gh authentication and an exact read-only existence query; confirmed execution creates one repository
permissions.file_write: external user-data SQLite config; confirmed GitHub creation writes one remote repository, while local repository writes remain separate interactive phases
permissions.subprocess: read-only git/ssh-add/provider status and existence checks; one separately confirmed gh repo create command
permissions.interactive: required before any Git mutation executed by the calling agent

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
